rapbattle.guide.title: MC Handbook
rapbattle.guide.page.1:
1. Getting Started

{b:lightning_rod} Mic — planks over a stick:
{i:oak_planks} any planks
{i:stick} stick
Keep it in your inventory.
Hit a mob with an empty hand:
[R] — battle
[N] — walk away
[LMB] again — fight
rapbattle.guide.page.2:
2. Battle Flow

First the beat and the mob's verse.
Then your turn: read on the beat, end with the table rhyme.
[R] — reroll rhyme.
Judge hits Respect bars.
rapbattle.guide.page.3:
3. Scoring & Wins

• Hit the 4th beat.
• Meaning beats volume.
• Flip mob targets ("FLIP").
• Silence hurts you.
Knockout ends early; close win makes the mob flee.
rapbattle.guide.page.4:
4. Mob Ranks

The badge above a mob is its rank. Your armor must be one step lower (whole set):
{i:leather} 1 — no armor
{i:chainmail_chestplate} 2 — leather
{i:iron_ingot} 3 — copper or chain
{i:gold_ingot} 4 — iron
{i:diamond} 5 — gold
{i:nether_star} boss — diamond
✓ ok, ✗ refuses
rapbattle.guide.page.5:
5. MC Style

• Puncher — from 0.
• Metronome — 500 Respect.
• Provoker — 1500.
Pick in /rapbattle → "MC Style" or /rapbattle style.
rapbattle.guide.page.6:
6. Microphones

{b:lightning_rod} Homemade — where it all starts. In the off-hand it flashes the beat.

{i:gold_ingot} Trophy mics drop from rank 5 mobs and bosses. Each has a perk that works in the off-hand.
rapbattle.guide.page.7:
7. Rookie Path

{b:lightning_rod} Craft a mic.
{i:rotten_flesh} Zombies, skeletons, spiders, sheep, cows — rank 1.
{i:leather} Leather — rank 2.
{i:copper_ingot} Copper armor — rank 3.
{i:iron_ingot} Iron — rank 4 (needs 300 Respect or 2 rank-3 species).
rapbattle.guide.page.8:
8. Act 2: Village

Beating a villager gives discounts (1/day); villager lives.
Raid: final-wave captain calls you out. Win to end the raid & get a Totem.
rapbattle.guide.page.9:
9. Act 3: Nether

Rank 4 gate: 300 Respect or 2 rank-3 wins.
Bastion brute calls you out: win for Bastion Guest.
Blazes drop rods; wither skeletons drop skulls (for Wither).
rapbattle.guide.page.10:
10. Act 4: To End

Rank 5 gate: 500 Respect or 2 rank-4 wins.
Endermen drop pearls.
Warden (mic, 500 Respect, rank 4+): stay quiet on his turn; win for 15m silence.
rapbattle.guide.page.11:
11. Act 5: Dragon

Needs: trophy mic (rank 5+), 1000 Respect, rank 5+/boss win, crystals cleared.
After winning, trophy mic stops Endermen gaze aggro.
/rapbattle legend.
rapbattle.guide.page.12:
12. Gangs & Rep

Rival colors: +1 rank.
Champions ♛ seek 3+ win streaks; close losers ask for rematch.
Wins give Street Cred; losses trigger Run! and theft.
rapbattle.guide.page.13:
13. PvP

Hit a player with an empty main hand to duel ([Y]/[N]).
1 round: each gets own rhymes & language. Nearby mobs hold truce.
rapbattle.guide.page.14:
14. Cheat Sheet
[R] — rap / reroll
[N] — walk away
[Y]/[N] — yes / no
Space — start, skip
[1–3] — lobby topic
/rapbattle — settings
/rapbattle leave — leave
/rapbattle guide, style
/rapbattle legend, clip
rapbattle.guide.page.15:
15. Ranks 1–3

{i:leather} 1 — no armor: zombie, skeleton, spider, sheep, cow, chicken.
{i:chainmail_chestplate} 2 — leather: fox, bee, slime, horse, goat.
{i:iron_ingot} 3 — copper or chain: villager, wolf, piglin, phantom.
Armor on a mob raises its rank.
rapbattle.guide.page.16:
16. Ranks 4–5

{i:gold_ingot} 4 — iron: creeper, enderman, witch, blaze, guardian.
Gate: 300 Respect or 2 rank-3 species.

{i:diamond} 5 — gold: golem, ravager, evoker, brute.
Gate: 500 Respect or 2 rank-4 species.
rapbattle.guide.page.17:
17. Microphones

{b:lightning_rod} Homemade — craft (page 1).
{i:gold_ingot} Golden — MVP of a rank 5 win.
{i:prismarine_shard} Deep — Elder Guardian.
{i:nether_star} Three-headed — Wither.
{i:echo_shard} Platinum — Warden.
{i:dragon_breath} End — Dragon.
Perk is in the tooltip, works in the off-hand.
rapbattle.guide.page.18:
18. Bosses (armor: diamond)

{i:prismarine_shard} Elder Guardian — beat a guardian first.
{i:nether_star} Wither — beat a wither skeleton first.
{i:echo_shard} Warden — any mic, 500 Respect, a rank 4+ win.
{i:dragon_breath} Dragon — rank 5+ trophy mic, 1000 Respect, a rank 5+ win, crystals down.
rapbattle.guide.page.19:
19. Respect

300 — rank 4 gate
500 — rank 5 gate, Metronome, Warden
1000 — Dragon
1500 — Provoker

In your own gang's gear the gates are halved.
From 300 Respect, rank 1–2 mobs give a quarter.
